items.question: How much did the UAE pledge to the Climate Impact Response Fund under the UAE's climate disaster fund contributions?
items.fact: UAE pledged USD 100 million to Climate Impact Response Fund

items.question: What minimum share of land and marine ecosystems does the Framework of the National Biodiversity Strategy 2031 aim to preserve?
items.gold: At least 21 per cent of land and marine ecosystems.
items.fact: Biodiversity Strategy 2031 aims to preserve at least 21 percent ecosystems
